responsibility: Declares the public interfaces for building and incrementally updating SSA form in GCC’s GIMPLE middle end. It exposes current-definition accessors, create_new_def_for, virtual-operand renaming markers, update_ssa control, deferred SSA-name release support, and extensive debugging/dumping entry points used by transformation passes that invalidate or extend SSA webs.
same_name_distinction: Exposes the callable SSA-update/build interface and debug helpers used by transformation passes. Unlike gcc/tree-into-ssa.cc, it is the declaration layer for update_ssa-related services, not the PHI-insertion and renaming implementation.
